name: io.github.youhaozhao/cninfo-mcp
title: CNINFO Listed Company Reports
description: Community MCP for querying Chinese listed-company reports and prospectuses from CNINFO.

environmentVariables.name: CNINFO_MCP_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a prepared Python 3.10+ executable with the declared runtime dependencies.

environmentVariables.name: CNINFO_MCP_DOWNLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit root directory that enables the file-download tool. Omit for read-only operation.
